title: Historical session switching
description: Measure unique completed historical sessions in stabilized app processes. Cold destinations have never been activated in that process. Warm destinations are activated once, returned to control, and then measured. Transcript-size latency is counterbalanced separately from the deliberately ascending memory-retention workload.

metrics.description: Trusted destination activation to correct content, first-fold paint, two presentations, and trusted input. Each configured repetition contributes five unique observations per workspace/state lane. Long-row sessions repeat the size trend with the same bytes in eight rows.

Framework-sampled summed RSS of the declared application process family. Maximum means the largest observed sample, not an operating-system true peak. Active means the progressive 1, 8, 32, and 128 MiB session-switch workload is running.
